mapper.insert: insert into booknest.`user_browse_history`(id, user_id, post_id, view_time, view_count, create_time) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{postId}, #{viewTime}, 1, #{createTime}) on duplicate key update view_time = values(view_time), view_count = view_count + 1
mapper.select: select h.id, h.post_id, h.view_time, h.view_count as my_view_count, p.title, p.summary, p.cover_image, p.category_id, p.user_id as author_id, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, c.name as category_name, u.username as author_name, u.avatar as author_avatar from booknest.`user_browse_history` h inner join booknest.`post` p on p.id = h.post_id left join booknest.`category` c on c.id = p.category_id left join booknest.`user` u on u.id = p.user_id where h.user_id = #{userId} order by h.view_time desc
select count(*) from booknest.`user_browse_history` where post_id = #{postId}
mapper.delete: delete from booknest.`user_browse_history` where user_id = #{userId} and post_id = #{postId}
